scope: Bounded Standard MIDI 0/1 phrase review and one reversible composition replacement; existing Composition v1, storage key, synthesis, exporter and statistical learner retained.

localVerification.build: passed as part of native production browser gate

testHistory.parser: Producer observed 15 failures and one pass against the callable placeholder before implementation; no initial RED log was retained. Final 21 cases passed.
testHistory.review: Producer observed eight initial failures. Independent review reproduced acceptance of a mutated public review title after text normalization. Exact raw public receipt comparison fixed that mismatch; the regression passed with the 16-case suite.
testHistory.independentOracle: Expected semantics were derived from the frozen contract and existing destination/export behavior without inspecting producer implementations. The first actual run passed all 23 cases; no claim of an observed initial failure.
testHistory.browser: The initial native-file case failed on the absent import control before UI implementation. The first integrated run passed 13 cases and failed one test-only wording assumption: the UI accurately said multiple raw tracks where the assertion expected shared. The assertion was corrected and a boundary-crossing case added. Final 35-case gate passed.

contract.supportedTiming: PPQN, one constant 40–240 BPM tempo; exact tick/PPQN arithmetic in composition
contract.review: Explicit channel, local instrument and name selection; cross-window notes reject; excluded attacks and omitted data disclosed.
contract.application: Exact-object full receipt and current-base check, native replacement confirmation, conditional raw-draft/proposal discard acknowledgement, one history commit. Native File reads guarded by file epoch, editor intent and composition generation.
contract.unsupported: Malformed/global unmodeled events reject the file. Ambiguous/shared/percussion/expressive/changing-state lanes stay visible but unselectable.

limitations: Synthetic MIDI validates interchange and synthesis, not General MIDI/DAW sound fidelity.
MIDI export480-tick rounding and omitted trailing-window/EOT rest are intentional.
Browser audio playback controls are exercised; exported PCM is the independent audible-signal evidence.
confirmations: Replace the composition with 2 notes in 1 parts (Imported scalar sine)? 3 source note attacks are excluded. Source beats 3 to 7 (end exclusive). limitations: Original synthetic MIDI establishes the supported interchange contract and local oscillator output, not fidelity to General MIDI instruments or arbitrary DAW performance.
No real microphone, vocal recognition, musical quality or new generative model was evaluated.
The existing MIDI exporter rounds to 480 PPQN; Composition v1 does not represent trailing window or end-of-track padding. Leading and internal rests remain.
The short two-note fixture and maximum 2048-note fixture are separate artifacts with their own byte counts, hashes and measurements.
Local native verification uses Linux Chromium; narrow viewport checks do not establish physical mobile/browser compatibility.
